summary: Two-byte exchange helper: swaps the single byte pointed to by a1 with the byte pointed to by a2 and returns the byte that originally sat at a1. Prelabelled as a structural twin of FloatClamp (004646c0) by cluster copy.

operations.description: read the byte at a1 into result (the field byte being exchanged)
write the byte from a2 into a1
write the saved original a1 byte into a2
return the original byte value that was at a1
